title: Publish runtime authoring sandbox contracts
summary: Publish the Studio-side contracts needed by HumbleControl's runtime proposal sandbox, including helper freshness expectations, patch artifact metadata, sandbox apply posture, proposal center anchors, and native catalog parity.
acceptance_criteria: Connection and prepare-edit manifests advertise runtime-freshness, proposal-center, patch-artifact, sandbox-apply, and source-apply-locked capabilities.
Every supported app export includes no-write descriptors for runtime readiness, proposal center, patch artifact, sandbox apply, and source apply lock.
The native supported-app catalog exposes the same Control anchors for the new runtime authoring sandbox descriptors.
Fallback guards, local preview tests, and documentation assert that sandbox apply is isolated from repository source truth.
Verification and promotion evidence are recorded before closing the ticket.
